contracts.commit_point: The run_pipeline execution step invoking _execute_remediation (src/autonomous.py:278), whose container-restart leg commits at SelfHealingEngine._heal_container's DockerScanner.restart_container call (src/healing.py:124).
contracts.declared_mechanism: AutonomousPipeline._check_approval evaluates every plan action via AppPolicyEngine.evaluate; FORBIDDEN logs a warning and returns False, APPROVAL_REQUIRED marks the plan requires_approval and returns False; run_pipeline then sets status 'awaiting_approval', publishes APPROVAL_REQUESTED, and returns before the execution step.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Executing a remediation plan action whose policy evaluation verdict is ActionVerdict.FORBIDDEN or ActionVerdict.APPROVAL_REQUIRED.
pending_binding_information: Whether the agent registry dispatched in _generate_plan (src/autonomous.py:402-418) is always an AI agent registry at runtime — dashboard lifespan wires orchestrator.registry into the pipeline (src/dashboard.py:1756-1762) but the constructor allows agent_registry=None (src/dashboard.py:520-527).
contracts.protected_operation: Execution of the autonomous incident remediation plan by AutonomousPipeline._execute_remediation, dispatched to SelfHealingEngine healing events that reach the Docker container restart.
contracts.protected_resource: Remediation plan actions targeting Docker containers (container restart effect) during autonomous incident resolution.
contracts.protection_obligation: Autonomous pipeline remediation execution (container-restart leg) must not run any plan action that AppPolicyEngine classifies FORBIDDEN or APPROVAL_REQUIRED; the _check_approval short-circuit must return the pipeline as awaiting_approval before _execute_remediation is invoked.
scope_limits: Plans with an empty actions list pass _check_approval trivially (src/autonomous.py:482-484); with no agent registry wired, the generated plan has no actions and the gate has nothing to block.

The same pipeline gate also protects the notification-retry communication leg, emitted as a separate contract; re_run_health_check and restart_monitoring_job mappings produce no external restart effect.
The healing engine applies its own independent SAFE-verdict gate at the restart commit (separate contract); this contract claims only the pipeline-level verdict short-circuit.
Post-execution effects such as event-bus publications and incident resolution are not claimed by this contract.
